author: RATTLEWARRIOR
body: I was thinking about buying a rank and wondering what /go was?
body_tagged: I was thinking about buying a rank and wondering what /go was?
title: What is / go ?

replies.author: Precise_
replies.body:
/go is a command that allows to go to any player pretty much
Ex. /go armoredwhale and that would take me to where he is.

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
If a player is on another server, or just somewhere else in a game, then you can use the /go command to teleport directly to that player.

Obviously you can't use it while you're playing during a game.
